title: Radetzky March
video_use_ideas: Punch in a crowd, a countdown, or a victory beat.
recording_performer: United States Marine Band, Col. John R. Bourgeois (album Sound Off, 1992)
legal_notes: This march is by Johann Strauss I (d.1849), not Johann Strauss II. Composition PD. Foreign status of U.S. government works varies. Page credits the 1992 album Sound Off.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
